set.body: Design a time-domain-to-trial decoding architecture that composes fMRI trial readout with MVPA, keeps temporal and trial-level nuisance semantics distinct, reuses Gale operator contracts and multivar second-order machinery, and defines staged JVM/JS validation gates. Deliverable: docs/plans/one-shot-mvpa.md.
set.title: Plan one-shot MVPA trial-readout architecture
